name_en: Yude dago — boiled wheat dough dumplings dusted with brown sugar
summary_ja: 小麦粉をこねて平たくのばし、ゆでてから黒砂糖をまぶす素朴なおやつ。米麦の二毛作が盛んな佐賀では自家製の小麦粉が常備され、農作業の合間や祭りで振る舞われてきたと伝わる。
summary_en: Wheat dough, kneaded and flattened, is boiled and then dusted with brown sugar — a plain snack from a region where double-cropped wheat kept flour on hand at home, eaten between farm chores or handed out at festivals.
source_title: ゆでだご 佐賀県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Futsu mochi — mugwort mochi filled with sweet bean paste
summary_ja: つきたての餅にゆでたよもぎを練り込み、あんこを包む。全国で桃の節句に菱餅を供えるのに対し、佐賀ではこの「ふつ餅」を供える地域があり、春の訪れを告げるおやつでもあるという。
summary_en: Pounded mochi is worked through with boiled mugwort and wrapped around sweet bean paste — where much of Japan offers diamond-shaped rice cakes at the Doll Festival, parts of Saga offer this mugwort mochi instead, and it doubles as a snack marking spring's arrival.
source_title: ふつもち 佐賀県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
